home.valueProp: We source decorative Jaipur blue pottery and brass gift pieces from vetted makers, pack for export, and ship with clear paperwork for your market.
bullets: Two ready lines today: blue pottery and brass décor for gift and home
Typical bulk shipment: FOB Mundra, Gujarat. Other terms available on request
Written quote with MOQ, unit price, lead time, and packing before you confirm
English invoices and packing lists. One contact for samples through delivery
Decorative ceramics labelled not for food use unless we agree a separate programme

faq.a: We are an export company working with Jaipur workshops. You get one English speaking contact, consolidated paperwork, and export packing specs we agree before production.
Our standard line is decorative only, with not for food use labelling. If you need food contact ceramics, tell us upfront so we can quote testing and a different specification.

faq.q: What is the usual shipping term?
faq.a: Most bulk orders are FOB Mundra. Samples are often collected EXW Jaipur. We can quote CIF to your port when you share destination and volume.
We send courier samples with a commercial invoice for customs. You approve colour and finish in writing before the bulk order goes into production.
Your company remains the importer of record in the EU. We provide product information and test reports where available so your compliance team can sign off.
Yes. Agree inspection on the purchase order. We share pre shipment photos during production either way.

importers.title: How to order
importers.lead: A straight path from first enquiry to goods on the water.

steps.title: Tell us what you need
steps.body: Product types, quantities, destination country, target retail price band, and any labelling rules in your market.

steps.title: Samples and approval
steps.body: We ship samples for your team to sign off. Changes are agreed in writing before bulk starts.

steps.title: Purchase order and production
steps.body: You receive a written quote: MOQ, price, lead time, carton plan, and payment milestones. Progress photos on request.

steps.title: Shipping documents
steps.body: Commercial invoice, packing list, and bill of lading. Certificate of origin when your broker needs it.

steps.title: Delivery and repeat orders
steps.body: Report transit damage with photos within the agreed window. Share a forecast when you plan a reorder.

export.complianceDecorative: Decorative gift and home products only unless stated on your PO. Your team confirms market rules in the EU or UK. We share material and test information we have from makers when you need it for your files.
